import json, subprocess, sys, time, random
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/dev')
import gen as G

def main():
    n = int(sys.argv[1]); start = int(sys.argv[2]); gen = sys.argv[3] if len(sys.argv)>3 else 'hard'
    bad = 0; slow = 0
    for seed in range(start, start+n):
        rng = random.Random(seed * 104729 + 5)
        if gen == 'hard':
            req = G.gen_plan_hard(rng, nf=22, nn=rng.randint(6,20), pathlen=rng.randint(2,9),
                                  cap=rng.randint(1,8), equal=rng.random()<0.5)
        else:
            req = G.gen_plan_big(rng, nf=22)
        line = json.dumps(req)+'\n'
        t0=time.time()
        m = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','/workspace/submission/main.py'],input=line,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120)
        dt = time.time()-t0
        if dt > 2: slow += 1; print('slow %.2f seed %d'%(dt,seed))
        b = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','/workspace/dev/bf.py'],input=line,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=1200)
        if m.stdout.strip() != b.stdout.strip():
            bad += 1; print('MISMATCH seed', seed)
            print('  main', m.stdout[:300]); print('  bf  ', b.stdout[:300])
            open('/workspace/tmp/bad.json','w').write(line)
            if bad > 3: break
    print(gen, 'checked', n, 'mismatches', bad, 'slow', slow)
    return 1 if bad else 0

sys.exit(main())
